good_for: Builds no-code AI agents that can do multi-step work across apps, like sales research or lead follow-up.
name: Relevance AI
watch_out: The free plan has been retired, so you pay from day one. Pro is $19/month on yearly billing ($29 month to month) and includes 2,500 Actions and $20 of vendor credits a month.

name: Copy.ai
good_for: Writing marketing copy, emails, and social posts fast with AI that follows your brand voice.
watch_out: The $24/month Chat plan is billed once a year ($288 up front); month to month costs $29.

name: Soundful
good_for: Generating royalty-free background music for videos, streams, and social posts.
watch_out: Plus is $9.99/month when paid month to month; the $4.99 price is shown under the Annual option. Free gives 1 MP3 download a month, and plan downloads reset each month instead of stacking.

name: Getimg.ai
good_for: Generating and editing AI images for art, thumbnails, and design mockups.
watch_out: The cheapest plan, Entry, is $15/month for 8,000 credits that do not roll over, and it only covers selected models. API use is not included in any plan.

name: Augment Code
good_for: Getting AI help writing and understanding code right inside your code editor.
watch_out: The $20/month plan is a usage allowance across their AI models, so heavy coding sessions can burn through it.

name: Gumloop
good_for: Building no-code AI automations that scrape sites, process data, and run on a schedule.
watch_out: Pro starts at $37/month and usage is credit-based, so large workflows can cost more than the base price.

name: Kagi
good_for: Ad-free web search with better results and no tracking.
watch_out: The $5/month Starter plan limits how many searches you get; heavy searching needs a pricier plan.

name: Kits AI
good_for: Training AI voices to sing or speak for your music tracks.
watch_out: The cheapest paid plan is Starter at $10 a month, and it limits how many custom voices you can train.

name: Listnr
good_for: Turning text into natural voiceovers for videos and podcasts.
watch_out: The $19/month plan caps you at 20,000 credits, which is roughly 2 hours of audio a month.

name: LTX Studio
good_for: Directing AI-generated video scenes with real camera-style controls.
watch_out: The $12/month price needs yearly billing and is currently shown as a limited-time offer, and the plan caps you at 8,000 credits a month.

name: Dzine.ai
good_for: Editing photos and generating design images with simple text prompts.
watch_out: The $8.99/month Beginner plan gives 1,000 credits a month that do not roll over, and Beginner users cannot buy extra top-up credits. Free accounts get 100 credits once, with no daily refill.

name: Cartesia
good_for: Adding ultra-fast, natural AI voices to apps and products.
watch_out: The $5/month Pro plan bundles 100K credits a month; go over the included credits and you pay for more.

name: Fireflies.ai
good_for: Auto-transcribing meetings and getting AI summaries without taking notes.
watch_out: The $10/month Pro price needs yearly billing ($18 month to month). Transcription is unlimited, but Pro storage is 8,000 minutes per person and you get 20 AI credits.

name: Krisp
good_for: Removing background noise from your calls and meetings.
watch_out: The pricing page shows only a free 7-day trial, no ongoing free plan. Core is $8/month on yearly billing ($16 month to month) and is priced per user.

name: Reclaim.ai
good_for: Auto-scheduling your workday, habits, and meetings around your priorities.
watch_out: The $10 Starter price needs yearly billing and is per seat; month to month it is $12 each, so costs add up as your team grows.

name: Jasper
good_for: Writing on-brand marketing content with an AI trained on your style.
watch_out: The $59/month Pro price needs yearly billing; month-to-month is $69, and it is built for teams rather than casual use.

name: Rytr
good_for: Writing short marketing copy and emails on a tight budget.
watch_out: The $7.50/month Lite plan needs yearly billing, so you pay about $90 up front; month to month it is $9.

name: Fathom
good_for: Recording video calls with free transcripts and AI summaries.
watch_out: The cheapest plan one person can buy is Premium at $16 a month on yearly billing ($20 month to month); the Team price advertised as $15 needs at least 2 users.

good_for: It turns a genre, mood, and length you pick into an original royalty-free track - the AI is trained only on music their own producers write and record, and every download comes with a worldwide, perpetual license.
name: Soundraw
watch_out: The cheapest Creator plan only downloads MP3s. WAV files and separate instrument stems need the Artist Pro plan - Artist Starter is MP3-only too.

good_for: It splits any song into vocals, drums, bass, and other stems in seconds, and cleans up noisy recordings - with desktop, phone, and DAW apps.
name: LALAL.AI
watch_out: Paid plans give unlimited relaxed-queue minutes but only a fixed monthly amount of fast-queue minutes (90 on Lite, 250 on Pro); the VST plugin and local desktop processing are Pro-only.
